one_month_reasoning: Inside the window: Q2 FY27 results and the Q3 guide on Dec 1 after the close (TIKR, Trefis). Credo's post-print moves have been large and negative even on beats (-20% after Sep 1). The bar: consensus Q2 $532M and Q3 $643M (Yahoo) need a Q3 guide of ~$640M+ to keep the >85% FY27 frame credible; the last two beats were only ~2% and Q1 non-GAAP EPS beat by 2.7%. The stock also bounced ~25% on Nov 23 from $99.86 as NVIDIA reinstated Jensen Huang, after a sector-wide -15% day on Nov 20 (ALAB the same), so some reversal risk is in the tape. I center the month slightly below spot (median ~$123.5) with ~31% downside and ~29% upside log spread (100% annual vol / 3.5 plus an earnings event), a mildly fatter left tail for the print.

fair_value.method: Driver build (Big-4 capex x Credo capture; GM - non-GAAP opex - SBC) gives FY28 revenue $3.47B and SBC-costed EBIT $1.40B; at the horizon an 18.0x P/E on the build's NTM EPS ($119.71, weight 0.6) and a 4.0% NTM FCF yield ($144.03, weight 0.4) blend to $129.44.

methods.inputs: NTM EPS at 2027-11-23 from the build (FY28 ~$6.4, FY29 ~$7.0 SBC-costed, tax 10-13%) x 18.0x

inputs_detail.derivation: FY26 ETR 1% (F91) and Q1 FY27 -0.5% (F92) rest on a 15-point excess-SBC deduction (F100, $73.4M F108) earned when the stock was $200-300; at ~$125 vesting values fall and the windfall shrinks, so the rate moves toward the 21% statutory rate (F94) less the ~7-point R&D credit (F104): ~13% by FY29.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Rate held at ~1-2% (company adjusted) adds ~10% to EPS and ~6% to the research target (12m).

anchor.note: FY26 ETR 1%; off-anchor because the SBC windfall (F100) depends on the share price, which has fallen ~60%

FY25->FY26 diluted +3.9% (181.2->188.2, F29/F30); no buyback; with SBC costed in EPS the share growth is set below history to avoid double counting the grant cost.
inputs_detail.variant_view: History +3.9%/yr would cut the research target (12m) ~2%.

inputs_detail.derivation: Current peer median NTM P/E 24.8x (10 peers; Zacks consensus via Nasdaq, 11-23 closes); CRDO own 14.9x on non-GAAP (124.88 / (0.433 x 6.31 + 0.564 x 9.71) = 124.88/8.21) -> 24.8 x (14.9/24.8)^0.8 = 16.5x; restated to SBC-costed EPS x (9.71/8.30 = 1.17) = 19.3x; less 1.3x for post-horizon AEC share loss and CPO (long_dated_risks) = 18.0x. Alternatives: peers.md (Oct snapshot) median 35.6x would give ~27x (+30% on this leg, stale); k = 1 (own multiple held) ~17.5x.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Without the long-dated haircut (19.3x) the research target (12m) rises ~4%.

inputs_detail.derivation: FY(N) mapped to CY(N-1): Credo ships cables and DSPs to ODMs ahead of the racks hyperscalers book as capex; FY27 (May-26 to Apr-27) <- CY2026 $733B, FY28 <- CY2027 $1,080B, FY29 <- CY2028 $1,330B, all the standing file's base case unchanged.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Low case (2026 720, 2027 880, 2028 800) or high case (750/1,360/1,750) from the same file; a CY-blend mapping (2/3 prior CY + 1/3 current CY) would raise FY28-29 capex ~10% and the research target (12m) ~8%.

inputs_detail.derivation: FY27 3.33: H1 = Q1 $479.0M reported + Q2 ~$530M (inside the $525-535M guide) = ~$1,009M; H2 ~$1,431M = electrical ~$1,080M (AEC incl. first 1.6T, +~12% q/q off Q2) + optical ~$350M (H2 of a ~$500M optical year, under the CFO's >$600M because it was reiterated not raised and the CEO said the PIC wins may slip into FY28) -> $2,440M / $733B. FY28 3.21: electrical +30% (below Big-4 capex +47%: component/memory price share of capex carries no Credo content per the capex file, first MaxLinear 1.6T revenue in 2027) to ~$2,520M + optical ~$900M (PIC wins ramp, Marvell-Lumentum integrated rival) + ALC/OmniConnect ~$50M = $3,470M / $1,080B. FY29 3.07: AEC share falls from ~90% toward ~75% as MaxLinear (target 20-30% of 1.6T, volume 2028) and Broadcom win sockets: electrical ~$2,635M + optical ~$1,300M + new ~$150M = $4,085M / $1,330B. Alternatives: Yahoo consensus FY27 $2.50B / FY28 $3.88B (capture 3.41 / 3.59); CFO >85% floor (FY27 >= $2,470M, 3.37).
inputs_detail.variant_view: Consensus-implied capture (FY27 3.41, FY28 3.59 on the Yahoo $2.50B/$3.88B) lifts the research target (12m) roughly 15-20%; a FY29 with no AEC share loss (capture ~3.2) adds ~5%.

inputs_detail.derivation: FY26 quarters 67.6/67.7/68.6/68.3% -> ~68.1% revenue-weighted; FY27 67.8% (Q1 68.0% actual, Q2 guide 67-69%); FY28 67.0% and FY29 66.0% as 1.6T AEC pricing meets a second source and optical (PIC/ZeroFlap) mix rises; Q4 FY26 guide was cut to 64-66% on new-product margins (24/7 Wall St, March 2026).
inputs_detail.variant_view: Holding 68% through FY29 (CFO 'in line' extended) adds ~3%; a 1.6T price war to 63% cuts ~8%.

FY27 = 95.2 + 102.5 + 110 + 118 = ~$426M (+53%, between CFO ~50% and Zacks ~55%). FY28 $520M (+22%: R&D for 1.6T/3.2T AEC, PICs, ALC); FY29 $600M (+15%).

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: NTM SBC-costed FCF at the horizon (~$1.16B) / 4.0%, plus net cash ~$1.8B at the horizon

inputs_detail.derivation: No debt on the filed balance sheet; cash $466.9M + ST investments $297.4M.
FY26 D&A $34.6M / revenue $1,335.1M = 2.6% (F36/F3); acquisition amortization of the $361.7M DustPhotonics intangibles is outside this EBIT basis.

FY26 CFO $464.3M vs net income $472.3M + SBC $182.6M + D&A $34.6M implies ~$225M working-capital and other build on +$898M revenue (~25%); inventory $313M (+25% q/q) and $102.4M of new capacity deposits keep it high; 18% taken as deposits are refundable.

Peer median trailing FCF yield 2.0% (ALAB 1.1, MRVL 1.6, AVGO 2.7, LITE 0.9, MTSI 2.0, CIEN 2.5, RMBS 4.4; secfacts, CFO-capex basis with SBC added back). Engine FCF here is after SBC, so restated: CRDO NTM SBC-costed FCF ~$1.0B / mkt cap ~$23.5B = ~4.3%; peer level ~3.3% (2.0% x ~1.65 NTM growth step-up); shrink 0.8 -> ~4.0%.
inputs_detail.variant_view: At 3.5% the leg rises ~14% and the research target (12m) ~6%; at 5% it falls ~8%.

downside.story: P10: AI capex digestion (Big-4 2027 toward the file's low case $880B, -19% vs base) meets share loss: Customer A (43% of Q1 revenue) dual-sources 1.6T AEC with MaxLinear/Broadcom, optical lands near $400M; inventory ($313M, +25% q/q) is worked down; GM -2 pts on pricing; P/E de-rates to ~13x and FCF yield to ~5%.

base.story: Median: FY27 revenue $2.44B (just under the >85% floor), FY28 $3.47B (+42%, ~11% under consensus) as AEC grows slower than Big-4 capex and optical ramps to ~$0.9B; SBC-costed EBIT margin ~40%, tax rising to 10-13%; 18x P/E and 4% FCF yield at the horizon.

upside.story: P90: Big-4 capex tracks the file's high case (2027 $1,360B), the >$600M optical target is beaten and the PIC wins ramp early, 1.6T AEC keeps ~90% share through FY28; P/E re-rates to ~23x, near the current peer median.

sbc_treatment.note: FY26 SBC $182.6M (F43), Q1 FY27 $88.0M (F47, 18% of revenue). EBIT and FCF are after SBC; shares grow 2%/yr (below the 3.9% history to avoid double counting). P/E restated from the peers' non-GAAP basis by the consensus non-GAAP/Zacks ratio.

reasoning: Skeptic lane. The stock is -60% from its June high on a sector de-rating (midterms and data-center limits, Intel and NVIDIA turmoil, Marvell-Lumentum) and a Credo-specific one: MaxLinear's CEO Kishore Seendripu put Credo's AEC share at '93% or maybe 99%' and targets 20-30% of 1.6T, while Credo's CFO Dan Fleming only reiterated the >$600M optical target. Downside evidence weighed: 43% one-customer concentration and 57% of receivables (10-Q), inventory +25% q/q, opex overshooting its Q1 range, beats shrinking to ~2%, Q1 EPS 16% under Zacks consensus, continuous insider sales (CTO ~27.5K shares most weeks, COO 100K on 9/25, no buys; OpenInsider), and a tax rate that rested on SBC windfalls. Against that: net cash $764M, no debt, no litigation, FCF positive, 115% revenue growth, Big-4 capex still rising ~47% into 2027 (standing file). Build: revenue = Big-4 capex (file base) x capture; I sit 2-11% under consensus revenue (FY27 $2.44B vs $2.50B; FY28 $3.47B vs $3.88B) and ~16-22% under Zacks EPS (FY27 ~$4.2 vs $5.02; FY28 ~$6.4 vs $8.30) mainly from AEC capture dilution, higher tax and SBC costed. Multiples from current peer consensus (peers.md is stale), shrunk k=0.8. Research target (12m) $129.44 (+3.6%); P10 $55 / P90 $221, a fatter left tail. Research limited: the MaxLinear transcript page failed, so its CEO's words come via a TIKR relay; Twelve Data estimates were unavailable.

peer median trailing FCF yield 2.0% (7 peers with FCF, secfacts) on CFO-capex (SBC added back); this set's engine FCF is after SBC, so the yield is set at 4.0%: own NTM SBC-costed FCF yield ~4.3% at $124.88 shrunk 0.8 toward a peer level ~3.3% (2.0% x ~1.65 NTM/LTM growth, restated for SBC)

drivers.label: Big-4 hyperscaler capex, calendar year ending 8 months into the fiscal year (CY2025 for FY26)
drivers.source: project AI-capex standing view base case (Big-4 2026/2027/2028), 2025 actual [secondary] from the same file
drivers.derivation: FY(N) mapped to CY(N-1): Credo ships cables and DSPs to ODMs ahead of the racks hyperscalers book as capex; FY27 (May-26 to Apr-27) <- CY2026 $733B, FY28 <- CY2027 $1,080B, FY29 <- CY2028 $1,330B, all the standing file's base case unchanged.
drivers.why: Credo's five hyperscaler customers (largest 43% of Q1 revenue per the 10-Q) are the Big-4 plus Oracle/xAI; their capex is the outside quantity its AEC and optical volumes ride on.

drivers.label: Credo revenue per $B of mapped Big-4 capex
drivers.source: 10-Q, Q1 FY27 call (Fleming CFO, Brennan CEO), MaxLinear CEO via TIKR, capex file
drivers.derivation: FY27 3.33: H1 = Q1 $479.0M reported + Q2 ~$530M (inside the $525-535M guide) = ~$1,009M; H2 ~$1,431M = electrical ~$1,080M (AEC incl. first 1.6T, +~12% q/q off Q2) + optical ~$350M (H2 of a ~$500M optical year, under the CFO's >$600M because it was reiterated not raised and the CEO said the PIC wins may slip into FY28) -> $2,440M / $733B. FY28 3.21: electrical +30% (below Big-4 capex +47%: component/memory price share of capex carries no Credo content per the capex file, first MaxLinear 1.6T revenue in 2027) to ~$2,520M + optical ~$900M (PIC wins ramp, Marvell-Lumentum integrated rival) + ALC/OmniConnect ~$50M = $3,470M / $1,080B. FY29 3.07: AEC share falls from ~90% toward ~75% as MaxLinear (target 20-30% of 1.6T, volume 2028) and Broadcom win sockets: electrical ~$2,635M + optical ~$1,300M + new ~$150M = $4,085M / $1,330B. Alternatives: Yahoo consensus FY27 $2.50B / FY28 $3.88B (capture 3.41 / 3.59); CFO >85% floor (FY27 >= $2,470M, 3.37).
drivers.why: Capture moves with AEC share, optical attach and the price content of capex; it is where the competition and concentration risks enter.

drivers.label: Gross margin (non-GAAP basis, ex SBC and acquisition amortization)
drivers.source: Q1-Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27 releases/call; CFO FY27 'broadly in line'
drivers.derivation: FY26 quarters 67.6/67.7/68.6/68.3% -> ~68.1% revenue-weighted; FY27 67.8% (Q1 68.0% actual, Q2 guide 67-69%); FY28 67.0% and FY29 66.0% as 1.6T AEC pricing meets a second source and optical (PIC/ZeroFlap) mix rises; Q4 FY26 guide was cut to 64-66% on new-product margins (24/7 Wall St, March 2026).
drivers.why: Mix (optical vs AEC) and competitive pricing set gross margin; fabless, so utilisation is the foundry's.

drivers.label: Non-GAAP operating expenses (ex SBC)
drivers.source: Q4 FY26 call (Fleming CFO: opex +~50% FY27), Q1 FY27 call (Q1 $95.2M, Q2 guide $100-105M), Zacks +~55%
drivers.derivation: FY26 base = GAAP gross profit ~$905M (rev x 68.1% less ~$4M SBC/amortization in COGS) - GAAP operating income $445.0M (F10) - opex SBC $181.2M = ~$279M. FY27 = 95.2 + 102.5 + 110 + 118 = ~$426M (+53%, between CFO ~50% and Zacks ~55%). FY28 $520M (+22%: R&D for 1.6T/3.2T AEC, PICs, ALC); FY29 $600M (+15%).
drivers.why: R&D intensity decides how much of the gross margin reaches EBIT while Credo fights for 1.6T sockets.

drivers.label: Stock-based compensation
drivers.derivation: FY27 = 88.0 reported + ~90 + ~92 + ~95 = $365M (DustPhotonics replacement and retention grants in the run-rate); FY28 $400M, FY29 $450M as grants at a share price 50-60% below the June high deliver more shares per dollar but dollar grants keep rising with headcount.
drivers.why: SBC is 15-18% of revenue and is costed in EBIT (GAAP-style EPS basis).

downside.story: P10: AI capex digestion (Big-4 2027 toward the file's low case $880B, -19% vs base) meets share loss: Customer A (43% of Q1 revenue) dual-sources 1.6T AEC with MaxLinear/Broadcom, optical lands near $400M; inventory ($313M, +25% q/q) is worked down; GM -2 pts on pricing; P/E de-rates to ~13x and FCF yield to ~5%.

upside.story: P90: Big-4 capex tracks the file's high case (2027 $1,360B), the >$600M optical target is beaten and the PIC wins ramp early, 1.6T AEC keeps ~90% share through FY28; P/E re-rates to ~23x, near the current peer median.

model_inputs.structure_note: Single reported segment, annual driver-led set (not quarterly: built by a forecaster for the round; the supervisor's reconciled set can be quarterised). Revenue = Big-4 capex (standing file base) x Credo capture; EBIT = revenue x GM - non-GAAP opex - SBC (SBC costed once; acquisition amortization excluded as in the Zacks basis). Value carried by a P/E leg (0.6) on the build's own NTM EPS and a FCF-yield leg (0.4) per the tech FCF-leg rule; no DCF, no SOTP (one segment).
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) capture path (FY27 3.33 vs consensus-implied 3.41; FY28 3.21 vs 3.59) is the main swing - consensus revenue would lift the research target roughly 15-20%; (2) tax path 6/10/13% vs FY26 1% (SBC windfall reversal); (3) FCF-yield level restated for SBC basis. peers.md (2026-10-26, prices 10-23) is older than the 21-day consensus window and pre-dates the Nov sector sell-off, so comps medians are recomputed from current Nasdaq/Zacks consensus and 11-23 closes; the table's figures are still listed for the gate. DustPhotonics contingent consideration ($300M equity, $10M liability) not in the share count beyond the CFO's ~200M. Probability of an equity raise <20% (net cash $764M, FCF positive): no financing event.
